description.p: A native COSMIC desktop reader for comic book archives (.cbz/.cbr), manga and comic series folders, and .epub books.

ul.li: Library view with covers, search, and a Continue Reading shelf
Scan whole library folders and group them automatically
Chapter-aware series folders with fast archive extraction
Single and dual page layouts, theater mode, fullscreen
Zoom and pan with trackpad or touchscreen pinch
Metadata and cover art from ComicVine and AniList

screenshot.caption: Your comics, manga, books and Jellyfin server in one library
Series pages with descriptions, release dates and progress
Books turn pages like an e-reader, one or two at a time
Choose the typeface, size, spacing and theme
Read comics and manga in theater mode, one page or two
Takes on your desktop's look, or a theme of your own

ul.li: Continue Reading now shows comics and books you started on your Jellyfin server or in another app, even before you finish a chapter or open them in Nebula
Convert to CBZ is removed: Jellyfin CBRs stream from a page index instead, and your files are never changed
Opening a Jellyfin CBR for the first time says "Creating index of CBR comic…" while its page index is made; later opens start right away
Updated COSMIC toolkit and libraries, with security fixes in the XML and HTTP/2 code
With a mouse, hold Ctrl (Cmd on a Mac) and turn the wheel to scroll down a zoomed comic page; add Shift to move sideways
Right-click menus: a Continue Reading card downloads or removes just the chapter it shows, and one-shots and books say Download Book
Fit to Width: press Space (or the header button) to make a comic page as wide as the window and scroll down it
Jellyfin comics open faster, page turns are quicker, and each page takes half the memory
Dark mode no longer switches to light when the system check fails, as could happen on a Mac when opening a comic
Hidden Mac "._" files and __MACOSX folders are no longer listed as chapters or pages
Mac: Cmd shortcuts, Trash without a Finder prompt, and Jellyfin progress kept on Cmd+Q
Windows: removing a download works while the comic is open, and drive roots no longer list the Recycle Bin
Library syncs and scans no longer freeze the window while saving
Fedora: install with dnf from the COPR repository timbo-slice/nebula-reader, and get updates with dnf upgrade
Theater mode (a black backdrop around the page) is on by default, and turns on once when updating; press T to switch it off
Touchscreens: drag a zoomed page with one finger, and flick to let it glide
Windows: two-finger touchpad scrolling pans a zoomed page instead of zooming
Jellyfin CBRs: right-click a series or chapter to build its page index ahead of time; indexed and solid chapters are marked on the series page
CBR comics open right away: pages are unpacked as they are needed instead of the whole series first
CBR comics from Jellyfin stream page by page instead of downloading whole; files that can't be read a page at a time ask before a big download
Convert to CBZ: repack CBR files unchanged into faster CBZs, with reading progress kept and the originals moved to the Trash
Every series and one-shot opens its own page with the description and details; Continue Reading goes straight to the reader
Right-click a cover to read, download, mark it read, show it in its folder, convert it or see its properties
A Downloads page lists Jellyfin downloads with their sizes and free space, removes them, and can move them to another folder or a USB drive
The page and download caches trim themselves to 2 GB
Issues without a story title no longer show ComicVine's "[untitled]"
Windows and macOS: Update now in the new-version banner downloads the update, checks it is signed with the Nebula release key and restarts into it
Every release file now comes with a minisign signature
Windows: installing over a running Nebula closes it instead of cancelling
Windows, macOS and KDE: the window has square corners and no extra outline inside the system's title bar and frame
Clicking beside the Settings or Details panel closes it, without opening what's under the click
The library tells you when a new version is out (close the banner to hide it for that version) and confirms when an update went through
The chapter list shows the whole series, grouped by volume, with a dropdown to jump between volumes
Jellyfin downloads: download whole series or single chapters and books to read when the server can't be reached
Progress made while the server is offline is sent once it's back
Full screen shows the time and battery in a corner
When zoomed in, a two-page spread is shown whole and the zoom comes back on the next page

description.p: Fixes the comic reader's chapter list and error messages showing through to the desktop in theater mode when the window isn't maximized.

ul.li: Colour themes: built-in themes, plus your own COSMIC theme (.ron) and KDE colour scheme (.colors) files
Follows your system's dark mode and accent colour while running, on every desktop; on Windows with the same accent shades as Windows' own apps
Series show their creators and years, issues their release dates, and books their author
The mouse wheel zooms comic pages directly; hold Shift for finer steps, or Ctrl to scroll a zoomed page
Two-page spreads show on their own, and each zoomed page starts at its top
Full screen hides the header bar until the pointer reaches the top
Jellyfin: what you're reading shows on the server's dashboard
Libraries on unplugged drives are kept, never deleted
An About section with an update check

description.p: Store listing update: Nebula Reader now appears under "Made for COSMIC" in the COSMIC Store, and the project moved to github.com/NotTimm/NebulaReader.

ul.li: Windows: the app now starts on PCs without the Visual C++ runtime installed
Jellyfin: the reader's title bar shows the server, whether it's online, and whether your progress has saved
Jellyfin: progress is saved once you settle on a page instead of on every page turn, and book positions sync too
Jellyfin: reading no longer fills the server's activity log with download entries
Local comics and books show their file path when you hover over "Local" in the title bar
First macOS build for Apple Silicon

description.p: The first stable release, under a new name: Cosmic Comic is now Nebula Reader.

ul.li: Comics, manga and EPUB books in one library, with covers, progress and a Continue Reading shelf
Books turn pages like an e-reader, one page or two side by side, with click-to-zoom images
Jellyfin libraries: Quick Connect sign-in, streamed pages, progress synced both ways
Runs on COSMIC, KDE Plasma, GNOME and Windows, taking on each desktop's look
Libraries and settings from Cosmic Comic carry over automatically

description.p: Jellyfin, and books that turn pages.

ul.li: Read comic and book libraries from a Jellyfin server: Quick Connect sign-in, pages streamed as you read, progress synced both ways
All / Local / Jellyfin switch in the library when you have both
Books turn pages like an e-reader, one page or two side by side; scrolling is still an option
Book images fit the page, and clicking one opens it to zoom and pan
Hover hints on every reader button; full screen is a single toggle
Button roundness setting outside COSMIC, and cleaner manga-tui chapter names

description.p: A new icon, and a Windows installer.

ul.li: New galaxy book app icon, on every platform
Windows: per-user installer with Start menu entry and "Open with" for comics and books, and the icon embedded in the exe

description.p: Runs on Windows, and takes on the look of the desktop it runs on.

ul.li: Native look on KDE Plasma (Breeze colours from your colour scheme), Windows 11 and GNOME, selectable under Settings, Appearance, Style
Native title bar on KDE and Windows
Windows build, plus AppImage and Flatpak packages
